info.title: dotnet-isolate
info.description: Isolates the exact set of projects and dependencies required to build a .NET project out of a larger solution, to shrink Docker build contexts and improve layer-cache reuse.

options.name: --clean
options.description:
delete and recreate the output directory instead of
merging into it

options.name: --restore
options.description:
emit only the files `dotnet restore` needs, for a
cacheable Docker restore layer
